title: MuonGS: Pretraining LLMs with Relaxed Weight-Norm Control
abstract: arXiv:2610.37647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight decay and explicit weight-norm constraints improve optimizer performance in language model pretraining, yet a unified understanding of why such control helps and how much is needed remains incomplete. We analyze norm control in Muon over the entire training trajectory using the \emph{accumulated effective learning rate}, $C_T=\sum_{t<T}\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F$, where $\eta_t$ is the nominal learning rate and $\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F$ is the effective learning rate relative to the weight norm. For bounded update directions, accumulation over any training interval bounds relative weight displacement. We show that vanilla Muon can accumulate only logarithmically, potentially limiting exploration and helping explain its slower empirical progress, whereas MuonW and MuonH guarantee at least linear accumulation under the stated conditions. translated_title: MuonGS：采用宽松权重范数控制的大语言模型预训练方法
translated_abstract: 权重衰减与显式的权重范数约束能够提升语言模型预训练中优化器的性能，然而对于这种控制为何有效、以及需要多强的控制，目前仍缺乏统一的理解。我们利用“累积有效学习率” C_T=\sum_{t<T}\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F（其中 \eta_t 为名义学习率，\eta_t/\|W_t\|_F 为相对于权重范数的有效学习率），对 Muon 在整个训练轨迹中的范数控制进行了分析。对于有界的更新方向，任意训练区间上的累积量会对相对权重位移形成约束。我们证明，原始版 Muon 只能实现对数级累积，这可能限制了探索，并有助于解释其经验进展较慢的现象；而 MuonW 与 MuonH 在所述条件下可保证至少线性的累积。进一步超越有界范数控制的框架，我们证明足够缓慢的范数增长可以保证更快的累积……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“累积有效学习率”分析框架，揭示原始Muon仅能实现对数级范数累积而MuonW/MuonH可达线性累积，并据此提出放宽权重范数控制的MuonGS方法以更高效地预训练大语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an accumulated effective learning rate framework showing that vanilla Muon achieves only logarithmic norm-control accumulation while MuonW and MuonH guarantee linear accumulation, and proposes MuonGS with relaxed weight-norm control for more efficient LLM pretraining.
